notes.title: BlockStar VR at CZ & SK Games week
notes.content:
BlockStar VR is in the final stages of development. Thanks to the great reactions of our players, we were motivated to bring more improvements and this livestream will be just about presenting the latest ones.
You can look forward to:
- The great Rob, presenting the game as usual
- More weapons
- New bonuses
- Powerups and fusion shots
- Brand new levels
- Live commentator improvements
- Brand new layout of the main menu elements
- and many other small improvements

Keep an eye out for our stream, and feel free to comment, your feedback is always helpful!

Also, as always, don't forget to check out the demo itself and add BlockStar to your wishlist if you like it!
